sentence: Heart failure means the heart is struggling to pump blood around the body effectively.
note: NHS: heart struggles to pump blood effectively

sentence: It does not mean the heart has stopped or is about to stop.
note: NHS: does not mean the heart has stopped or is about to stop

sentence: Common symptoms include breathlessness during activity or when lying down, tiredness, swollen ankles and legs, and feeling lightheaded.
note: NHS summary listed these; blended across NHS main and living-with pages

sentence: Some people also have a cough that keeps coming back at night, or a fast heart rate.
note: Summary: persistent night cough, fast heart rate (NHS main and living-with)

sentence: Heart failure usually needs lifelong treatment and often gets worse over time, according to the US National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute.
note: NHLBI: usually requires lifelong treatment and often worsens over time

sentence: Fluid build-up can show as weight gain, swollen ankles or worsening breathlessness.
note: NHLBI/summary: fluid buildup can show up as weight gain, ankle swelling, worsening breathlessness; exact page within the summary not identified

sentence: Other signs of fluid build-up include swelling of the legs or abdomen, a worsening cough, trouble sleeping flat, dizziness and confusion.
note: Summary listed these warning signs; attributed to a blend of Berkshire Healthcare and NHLBI pages, not confirmed which carries each

sentence: The US National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute describes left-sided heart failure as the more common form.
note: NHLBI search summary: left-sided described as the more common form

sentence: It has two main types, which are named after the ejection fraction, a measure of how much blood the left side of the heart pumps out with each beat.
note: Textbook definition of ejection fraction; not retrieved as text

sentence: In heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, the left side of the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the rest of the body.
note: NHLBI: in HFrEF the left side is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the rest of the body

sentence: In heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, the left side is too stiff to relax fully between heartbeats.
note: NHLBI: in HFpEF the left side is too stiff to fully relax between heartbeats

sentence: The British Heart Foundation also describes a mildly reduced group that sits between these two.
note: BHF booklet: mildly reduced category between HFpEF and HFrEF

sentence: Left-sided heart failure is the main cause of right-sided heart failure, and what starts on the left can progress to the right.
note: NHLBI: left-sided is the main cause of right-sided; can progress

sentence: Long-term, or chronic, heart failure is often caused by other medical conditions that damage or overwork the heart.
note: NHLBI causes page: chronic heart failure often caused by other conditions that damage or overwork the heart

sentence: Sudden, or acute, heart failure can be caused by an injury or infection that damages the heart, a heart attack or a blood clot in the lung.
note: NHLBI causes page: acute heart failure causes as listed

sentence: A GP checks the symptoms and may arrange a blood test.
note: NHS summary: GP checks symptoms and may order a blood test

sentence: NHS England advises GPs to arrange a natriuretic peptide blood test, called NT-proBNP, for people with suspected heart failure.
note: NHS England: GPs should order an NT-proBNP blood test for suspected heart failure

sentence: The NICE guideline links the result to how soon a specialist assessment and an echocardiogram should happen, with higher results prompting faster referral.
note: NICE NG106 visual summary: result decides next step; higher levels mean urgent referral and earlier echo (thresholds deliberately not quoted)

sentence: If the blood test suggests heart failure, the GP refers the person to a specialist heart failure team, who may offer further tests.
note: NHS: GP should refer to a specialist heart failure team and further tests may be offered

sentence: The NHS says these tests may include blood and urine samples, an electrocardiogram (ECG), scans such as a chest X-ray, echocardiogram and MRI scan, and tests to check the lungs.
note: NHS diagnosis page: tests list as returned

sentence: An echocardiogram is an ultrasound scan of the heart.
note: Plain undisputed definition

sentence: NICE describes it as used to exclude important valve disease and to assess how well the left ventricle, the main pumping chamber, works.
note: NICE: echo used to exclude important valve disease and assess systolic and diastolic function of the left ventricle; 'main pumping chamber' is a gloss

sentence: The NHS says medicines are the main treatment for heart failure, and that surgery may help some people.
note: NHS treatment page: medicines are the main treatment; for some people surgery may help

sentence: It also describes lifestyle changes as a core part of care.
note: NHS treatment page: lifestyle changes core part of care

sentence: Treatment will usually be needed for life, and people often take two or three different medicines.
note: NHS treatment page: treatment usually needed for life; often 2 or 3 medicines

sentence: Some people have an implanted device.
note: NHS summary: options include implanted devices

sentence: The most common is a cardiac resynchronisation therapy (CRT) device, and versions that also include a defibrillator are usually called CRT-Ds.
note: NHS treatment page: CRT most common; with defibrillator called CRT-D

sentence: Surgical options include heart valve surgery, left ventricular assist devices and heart transplant.
note: NHS treatment page list

sentence: The NHS says a heart transplant may be offered if other treatments are not helping.
note: NHS treatment page: transplant may be offered when treatments are not helping

sentence: The NHS states that everyone diagnosed with heart failure should be offered cardiac rehabilitation, which is a programme that includes exercise.

sentence: Daily weight checks help to spot fluid build-up early.

sentence: A healthy diet, staying active, not smoking and keeping to a healthy weight all help.

sentence: One NHS hospital guide suggests limiting salt and not adding it at the table or in cooking.

sentence: It advises drinking very little alcohol, and some people are advised to stop completely if alcohol contributed to the condition.
note: Summary: sources advise very little alcohol; complete stop where alcohol caused the condition; attributed to first result, not confirmed

sentence: People with heart failure should be offered a flu vaccine every year and a one-off pneumococcal vaccine, the NHS says.

sentence: The NHS also says monitoring should happen at least every six months.
